title: Tukada
headline: Tukada Website and E-Shop Design
scope: UX/UI · E-shop · E-commerce · Mobile design · Responsive design · Landing page design

paragraphs: A company specializing in custom commercial vehicle engineering, building everything from mobile labs to high-end service vans, needed a stronger digital presence. Their expertise spans modular shelving, lighting, electronics integration, and certification, but their website didn’t yet reflect the scale of their work or support part sales online.
They wanted a way to showcase their craftsmanship while opening a new channel for selling custom-made components.
While their engineering solutions were well recognized, the digital experience lagged behind. The business needed:

items: A modern landing page that communicates expertise and showcases project examples
An e-shop to sell custom-made parts directly to clients
A conversion-focused structure to turn interest into sales and inquiries

paragraphs: The goal was to design a digital platform that combines **storytelling with functionality**: a landing page to present complex engineering solutions with clarity, and an e-commerce storefront tailored to selling specialized parts in a professional, user-friendly way.
**The landing page** highlights engineering projects, service capabilities, and a clear value proposition structured to guide visitors naturally toward exploring parts and solutions.

**E-commerce storefront** with a tailored catalog of custom components, product detail pages with specs and visuals, and an intuitive checkout experience designed for direct orders and quote requests.
The system was integrated with marketing and tracking tools, supporting immediate transactions and long-term growth.

The new platform gave the company a **professional online identity** that reflects their technical expertise while opening a scalable sales channel for custom parts. Visitors can now explore project examples, gain confidence in the brand, and purchase specialized components directly — all within a unified, modern digital experience.
